Autonomic mechanism

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

A healthy athlete has a slight increase in heart rate when inhaling and a decrease when exhaling. Every P wave is followed by a QRS complex, and the PR interval is unchanged. Which mechanism best explains the cyclical rate variation?

  1. Intermittent failure of AV-node conduction
  2. Alternating ventricular ectopic pacemakers
  3. A continuously reentrant atrial circuit
  4. Repeated obstruction of coronary flow with each breath
  5. Respiratory modulation of vagal influence on the sinus node
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

Respiratory modulation of vagal influence on the sinus node

Changing parasympathetic input alters sinus-node cycle length without disrupting the sinus origin of the beats.

Understanding the options

Respiratory modulation of vagal influence on the sinus node
Changing parasympathetic input alters sinus-node cycle length without disrupting the sinus origin of the beats.
Intermittent failure of AV-node conduction
That would change atrioventricular conduction or produce dropped ventricular beats.
Alternating ventricular ectopic pacemakers
That would not preserve the same sinus P-wave sequence before each QRS.
A continuously reentrant atrial circuit
This is not the mechanism of physiologic respiratory rate variation.
Repeated obstruction of coronary flow with each breath
The benign breathing-linked rhythm does not require myocardial ischemia.
